profile: Actual native image inspection plus independent full City CPU geometry reconstruction
blindComparison: This is an identified-build defect diagnosis, not a blind reference comparison. No evaluator preference, element satisfaction, frame-rate result or whole-product success is inferred.
scope: FAIL is limited to unsupported roof-scatter geometry visible in the Arcade image. No product or CI files were edited by this review. The diagnostic score is not a concept-element rating.

target.geometryContinuity: git diff between tested commit and checkout found no difference in src/world, src/content/world_data.js or src/core/rng.js.

findings.problem: An AC body and three small rubble pieces are generated at base y=10.05 over a building gap. Nine sampled footprint points per object have no upward-facing support near that base; the first support below is street or pavement at y=0 to 0.14. The native image shows disconnected cuboid and debris silhouettes in the corresponding sky region.
findings.why: These are visibly disconnected ordinary world props. A missing support requirement produces the geometry even when its detailed chunk is enabled, so changing chunk visibility would not repair placement.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed for these generated objects: the roof branch of City._scatter places props at zone.y after only rejecting collision overlap above that height. marrowroof_s covers the terrace gap and uses fixed y=10.05. The objects originate from this branch, not building roofClutter. Exact pixel-to-face attribution remains a projection inference because FOV was not recorded.
findings.fix: Make roof-scatter placement use actual supporting roof surfaces and heights across the generated footprint, including offset debris. Target 0 unsupported roof placements in a full City.build geometry check using ../cpu-city-fixture.mjs. Then run node tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs, record the actual camera projection matrix and inspect the unchanged Arcade view for removed floating silhouettes and retained supported roof dressing. Do not treat a changed mesh/face ID alone as success.

evidence.exception: One AC-edge DoubleSide ray hit a different rubble bottom at y=10.050000190734863, normal [0,-1,0]. This was retained in the evidence and is not an upward supporting roof surface.
evidence.separateRefutation: Independent full City reconstruction matched all four world triangles exactly and refuted the missed-same-height-roof hypothesis. Building-footprint bounds independently place all target samples in a building gap.

visibility.interpretation: The reconstructed target chunk is visible at the recorded camera position. Support rays also include hidden mesh parents; they did not recover a supporting roof. This refutes chunk-distance culling as the explanation for the missing support of these props, not every possible culling defect in the game.

source: src/world/city.js: City._scatter collision-only inside check and roof case
src/content/world_data.js: terrace helper and marrowroof_s scatter
generation.gapExplanation: terrace omits the whole bay when it intersects an avoid span. The actual gap is therefore wider than the nominal [-108,-92] interval. A broad roof-scatter rectangle does not inherit those omitted building footprints.

measurementBoundary.cpu: Actual City.build, MeshBuilder geometry, collision world and visibility update ran in Node. Canvas2D drawing/text metrics and texture/material appearance were stubbed; no GPU rendering or actor fixture was performed.
measurementBoundary.projection: The recorded report omits fov/aspect/projectionMatrix. The CPU reconstruction uses aspect 667/375 from the CSS viewport and tests FOV 55 through 58. The actual source camera approaches 58 degrees during idle, but the tested frame FOV is not independently measured.
measurementBoundary.pixelCorrespondence: At FOV 58 the AC body projects to [587.5099,76.2545,625.4497,106.2410], matching the inspected native cuboid region. The exact (606,91) ray hits other geometry for some alternative FOV values. World support measurements do not depend on this FOV assumption.
measurementBoundary.supportSampling: Primary rays use interior footprint samples -0.45/0/0.45 and start below the base. Independent rays use footprint -0.5/0/0.5, start above the base and exclude self primitive faces. This is sampled support, not a proof of every infinitesimal contact point. Actual full building footprint bounds provide additional independent evidence.
measurementBoundary.unrelatedPanel: The tall rusty shape near (660,195) reconstructs to the fireEscape structure at x=-110,z=22.5. Its wall attachment/support has not been established here, so it is not included in the confirmed roof-scatter finding.
measurementBoundary.nextBrowserEvidence: Record camera fov, aspect and projectionMatrix in the existing native capture; record ray hits and visible parent IDs for the named pixels if exact native pixel ownership is required. Preserve pre/post images and compare actual support and placement after the fix.

reusableFixture.boundary: Whole City geometry count, including hidden/backdrop/sign meshes; not a draw submission count. Material rendering appearance is not faithful. The fixture imports the current checkout and must be remeasured after changes.
